name: proactive-compact-mod
description: Lets the agent prepare and choose its own compaction instead of suffering auto-compact: asks it to save its memories at a context threshold, and gives it tools to read its context and compact itself.

enabled.title: Compact requests enabled
enabled.description: Sends the compact request and the reminder at their thresholds. The tools stay available either way.

requestThreshold.title: Compact request threshold (%)
requestThreshold.description: Raw context fill that triggers the compact request.

reminderThreshold.title: Reminder threshold (%)
reminderThreshold.description: Raw context fill that triggers the reminder.

compactFloor.title: Compact floor (%)
compactFloor.description: Below it, the compact_session tool refuses to compact.

requestMessage.title: Compact request message
requestMessage.default: This session's context has reached {percent}% (threshold {threshold}%). Prepare for a compaction: check that your memories, and any tracking documents, hold everything not yet recorded, especially decisions, the state of the work and commitments made. Once they are up to date, and if the moment is right, call the {tool} tool, passing in `instructions` what the summary must keep. If the moment is wrong, for instance in the middle of a task or while waiting for a subagent, say so in one sentence and call the tool later.

reminderMessage.title: Reminder message
reminderMessage.description: Empty: the compact request message is reused for the reminder.

messageSuffix.title: Message suffix
messageSuffix.description: Appended to the compact request and the reminder; meant for per-project overrides.

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: Passed to the summary, before the agent's own.
